name: Igoudar Numerique / Igoudar Dakhla green datacenter campus
developer: Moroccan Ministry of Digital Transition and Administrative Reform; Ministry of Energy Transition and Sustainable Development; Dakhla-Oued Eddahab regional authorities; Mohammed VI Investment Fund; Caisse de depot et de gestion (CDG)
notes: Planned next-generation green datacenter campus in Dakhla with target capacity of 500 MW. Official ministry announcement reports a partnership convention to operationalize the Igoudar Numerique campus and launch strategic studies following earlier 2025 agreements; DCD/Reuters reported Morocco's plan for a 500 MW renewable-powered data center in Dakhla, a Moroccan-administered city in disputed Western Sahara. Timeline and final financing not yet fixed.
